_approach: The canonical Jersey club 5-kick skeleton: kick on 16th positions 1,5,9,12,15 (gaps of 4-4-3-3-2), the last kick given the shortest, quietest tail as a pickup. The rim role stands in for the sampled 'bed squeak' (from Trillville's 'Some Cut') on the off-16ths, closed hats sit on 2 and 4 only per the genre's sparse-hat convention, and the clap answers the kick run rather than sitting on a flat backbeat.
